# 2 Baruch Chapter 70 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**1** "Now hear about the eighth black waters and the bright waters that come after them."

**2** "The black waters you saw after the seventh bright ones represent the whole world that comes after those events — the deeds of the nations and all the evils that will happen in those times."

**3** "Great upheavals will strike, many wicked acts will be committed, apostasy will be widespread, many kings will rise and quickly fall."

**4** "There will be turmoil throughout the whole earth; people will hate their neighbors and drag them into war."

**5** "Those who do not know the law will be killed by those who do not know what is good."

**6** "Wars and disasters will sweep the earth; everywhere sword will clash with sword; the nations will descend into chaos."

**7** "Then the time of my Messiah will arrive. He will cause people to call on my name, and all the good things I have decreed for my people will be given to them."

**8** "A great fire will burn across the earth; the mountains will melt, the valleys tremble, and the waters change their very nature."

**9** "Those who have been living in darkness will come into the light, and the righteous will be separated from the wicked."

**10** "These are the eighth black waters you saw."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
